fixtureBoundary: Artificial positions, speeds, clock/deadline and final-lap thresholds only in isolated rule fixtures; independent normal-input eight-course wins never use these writes
tests: eight distinct closed courses, three environments, straight-segment gates and safe recovery points
three-second countdown prevents movement and race-clock advance under held controls
gas accelerates, steering rotates relative to heading, stationary steering cannot pivot
release coasts down and braking stops without reversing
speed is capped by production constants and oversized frame deltas are bounded
road shoulder slows the vehicle while leaving steering available
road-edge collision resets safely, adds three seconds and locks repeated reset
manual recovery keeps ordered progress and current lap, charges time and restores road heading
swept gate detects high-speed crossing, rejects reverse, wide misses and repeated line contact
finish and out-of-order gates cannot advance the next required checkpoint
all ordered forward gates and adequate route travel are required for a lap
reverse driving is visible and cannot collect a checkpoint or lap
discontinuous route jump is recovered without awarding skipped checkpoints
final lap settles exactly once and later inputs do not alter won race
deadline failure has priority over a same-step final finish crossing
pause freezes countdown, car, lap, timer and input effects
checkpoint reload preserves lap and gate progress, restores only safe position and adds recovery penalty
corrupt versions, times, lap histories, gate order and resource counts are rejected
resume close to deadline loses once; saved countdown restarts paused without charged racing time
fixed-step update is independent of frame chunking and authored tracks stay immutable
